train_serve_mismatch_analysis.training_input_source: Ground-truth Pascal VOC bounding box annotations from RDD2022 XML files.
train_serve_mismatch_analysis.serving_input_source: image_detector.py classical edge & morphological heuristics run on uploaded RGB frames.
train_serve_mismatch_analysis.mismatch_implication: Heuristic detector generates false-positive crack candidates on textured asphalt and may underestimate bounding box area, creating a feature distribution shift between training and live inference.

detector_reliability_summary: The computer vision detector is a lightweight, edge/contour-based heuristic localized detector suited for CPU demonstration environments. Because training is conducted on tabular features derived from ground-truth Pascal VOC annotations, live serving incurs train/serve mismatch. Automated bounding boxes must be treated as provisional inspection suggestions.
